summary: The main article describes a visible-light-induced radical hydrodifluoromethylation of alkenes using a phosphonium salt. It includes a scheme of previous work, an optimization table for reaction conditions, a substrate scope scheme, and a mechanistic investigation scheme.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: Hydrodifluoromethylation of alkenes.
items.description: This scheme summarizes previous literature methods for the hydrodifluoromethylation of alkenes and introduces the current work using phosphonium salt 2.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Optimization of the reaction conditions a
items.description: This table details the screening of reducing agents, solvents, bases, and reagent ratios to optimize the yield of the hydrodifluoromethylation product.

items.heading: Scheme 2
items.caption: Hydrodifluoromethylation of alkenes. Isolated yields.
items.description: This scheme illustrates the substrate scope of the reaction, showing various functionalized alkenes and their corresponding hydrodifluoromethylated products.

items.heading: Scheme 3
items.caption: Mechanistic investigations.
items.description: This scheme presents experimental evidence for the radical mechanism, including radical trapping with TEMPO and light/dark control experiments.

items.heading: Scheme 4
items.caption: The proposed mechanism.
items.description: This scheme outlines the proposed catalytic cycle involving single electron transfer, radical formation, and hydrogen atom abstraction.
